claims.text: LDA and Gibbs sampling were applied to evaluate ISWC and WWW conference publications from 2013-2017, focusing on discovering relationships between topics and paper features.
The authors used Gibbs sampling to estimate parameters of LDA, which helped in analyzing the topics of the publications.
The study involved extracting abstracts and titles from ISWC and WWW publications to implement LDA and analyze topic trends.
